text:
mike: Quick sync — putting together an env matrix for the next perf run. We keep seeing kernel selection + driver differences shift latency for long-context jobs. Need an apples-to-apples smoke plan to isolate causes.

mike: Goal: enumerate GPU SKU + driver + CUDA + container image + kernel flags, run short replay + short synthetic, capture kernel selection, KV hit profile, batch size distribution, and perf counters.

tara: SGTM. Do we have a canonical list of SKUs and driver versions to cover? I can map against current Dedicated fleet.

chen: Suggestion: test these combos as a minimal set: A100-40GB (510.47), A100-80GB (525.*), H100 (535.*) with CUDA 11.8 and 12.1 images. Also run a baseline on g4dn for lower perf point.

jess: Adding that we should pin the container image to sha256 and the runtime flags in job metadata. Example job config snippet:

```
GPU_SKU=A100-40GB
CUDA_VER=11.8
DOCKER_IMAGE=redwood/infer-runtime:2026-03-01@sha256:abcd
KERNEL_FLAGS="--use-fused-attn --matmul-opt=heuristic"
BATCHER_POLICY=latency_p95
REPLAY_WINDOW=600
```

oliver: Important: batching heuristics can adapt differently with slight clock drift or driver changes. Add a warmup phase that primes KV cache and a cold-run to see cache miss penalty.

mike: Agreed. Plan for each combo: 5m warmup (replay of representative traces), 10m measured replay, 10m synthetic mix with varied prompt lengths. Collect traces: kernel selection logs, cupti timeline, per-token latency, and KV cache hit/miss counts.

chen: For profiling, please avoid nvprof in CI — use CUPTI with trace sampling. It scales better on H100 and doesn't block. Also capture `nvidia-smi topo --matrix` output for node-level differences.

infra-bot: CI job triggered: perf-smoke/1774506789-gpu-matrix (status: queued)

tara: One more: we should freeze scheduler kernel whitelist per-run so the runtime doesn't switch kernels mid-run. Add `KERNEL_LOCK=1` env to the job. That lets us see true delta from driver/arch not runtime auto-swap.

jess: Noted. Also include a small reproducer to force the kernel path we suspect: inline prompt that drives long-decoding with attention window of 8k. Save the prompt set with the run artifacts.

mike: OK I'll author the job template and upload to /infra/perf/jobs. After smoke results we can pick top 3 failing combos for full-hour runs and deeper CUPTI capture. Thanks folks :thumbsup:

oliver: If we see perf regressions, capture the exact kernel binary names + timestamps so we can compare PTX/ISA differences. Those helped us catch the matmul fallback last quarter.

mike: Good call. I'll include kernel filenames in the artifact manifest. Ending here — will post job links when CI spins up.
